narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as an educational snippet to correct common misconceptions about electromagnetic radiation from household devices. The creator, Li Ke Tai Tai, explains that non-ionizing radiation is not harmful, emphasizing that psychological stress from fear and physical strain from screen time are much more detrimental to health.
